captures.title: Desktop workspace
captures.description: The genuine desktop workspace with an explicitly selected public repository and live details.
captures.descriptionYue: 真實桌面工作空間，顯示明確選取嘅公開倉庫同即時詳細資料。

captures.title: Repository details
captures.description: The real Ding-Ding-Projects/material-git repository result, its context controls, and provider-authored details.
captures.descriptionYue: 真實 Ding-Ding-Projects/material-git 倉庫結果、相關控制項同提供者原始詳細資料。

captures.title: Issues: real empty state
captures.description: The all-state issues filter returned zero records for this repository at capture time. No sample records were added.
captures.descriptionYue: 擷取嗰陣，呢個倉庫嘅全部狀態 issue 篩選傳回零項記錄。冇加入示範記錄。

captures.title: Pull requests: real empty state
captures.description: The all-state pull-request filter returned zero records for this repository at capture time. No sample records were added.
captures.descriptionYue: 擷取嗰陣，呢個倉庫嘅全部狀態 pull request 篩選傳回零項記錄。冇加入示範記錄。

captures.title: Actions history and job results
captures.description: Live Actions history with 19 returned runs. The selected release run and job show their actual failure state; other visible runs include successful results.
captures.descriptionYue: 即時 Actions 記錄，傳回 19 次執行。所選發佈執行同工作顯示真實失敗狀態；其他可見執行亦有成功結果。

captures.title: Release history and notes
captures.description: Eleven real release records, with Material Git 0.16.1 selected and its original release notes. The installer source differs from this capture source.
captures.descriptionYue: 十一個真實版本記錄，選取 Material Git 0.16.1 並顯示原始版本說明。安裝程式來源同呢張畫面來源唔同。

captures.title: Settled active account and credential source
captures.titleYue: 已載入使用中帳戶同憑證來源
captures.description: The settled native account request reports one authenticated active account. Environment credentials take precedence over saved accounts; no credential value is visible.
captures.descriptionYue: 已完成嘅原生帳戶請求傳回一個已驗證使用中帳戶。環境憑證優先於已儲存帳戶；畫面冇顯示憑證內容。

captures.title: Desktop preferences
captures.description: The actual General preferences view, with language, display name and playfulness controls.
captures.descriptionYue: 真實一般偏好設定畫面，顯示語言、顯示名稱同趣味程度控制項。

captures.title: Local source control
captures.description: Native Git inspects the actual public source checkout with no changed files and explicit repository trust controls. No commit operation was performed for this capture.
captures.descriptionYue: 原生 Git 檢查實際公開來源工作目錄，冇已修改檔案，並顯示清楚嘅倉庫信任控制項。擷取畫面冇執行提交操作。

captures.title: Host-scoped repository picker
captures.description: The real repository picker filters the authenticated host’s public repository results before an explicit selection.
captures.descriptionYue: 真實倉庫選擇器喺明確選取之前，篩選已驗證主機嘅公開倉庫結果。

captures.title: Ten export-format choices
captures.description: The native export dialog for 11 selected release records, with CSV selected and its type-preservation limits disclosed. This frame does not prove a save operation.
captures.descriptionYue: 十一個所選版本記錄嘅原生匯出對話框，選取 CSV 並清楚說明類型保留限制。呢張畫面唔代表儲存操作已驗證。

captures.title: Completed native download queue
captures.description: The genuine SHA256SUMS release asset completed: 247 bytes, with its saved SHA-256 matching the provider digest. Recovery is explicitly limited to this session.
captures.descriptionYue: 真實 SHA256SUMS 版本檔案已完成下載：247 位元組，儲存檔案嘅 SHA-256 同提供者校驗碼相符。復原清楚限制於今次工作階段。

captures.title: Verified download progress
captures.description: The independent progress dialog shows the real completed 247-byte asset and SHA-256 verification. No destination path or credential is disclosed.
captures.descriptionYue: 獨立進度對話框顯示真實完成嘅 247 位元組檔案同 SHA-256 核對結果。冇顯示目的地路徑或憑證。

captures.title: Local converter workspace
captures.titleYue: 本機轉換工具工作空間
captures.description: The actual converter workspace displays available adapter records and PDF limits before a source is selected. This frame does not demonstrate a completed conversion.
captures.descriptionYue: 真實轉換工具工作空間喺未揀來源之前，顯示可用轉換配接器記錄同 PDF 限制。呢張畫面唔代表已完成轉換。

captures.title: Cloud workspaces: real empty state
captures.titleYue: 雲端工作空間：實際空白狀態
captures.description: The actual provider cloud-workspace list returned zero records. No cloud resource was created for a screenshot.
captures.descriptionYue: 實際提供者雲端工作空間清單傳回零項記錄。冇為截圖建立雲端資源。

captures.title: Light desktop theme
captures.description: The same built desktop and live repository using the persisted light theme.
captures.descriptionYue: 同一個建置桌面同即時倉庫，使用已儲存嘅淺色主題。

captures.title: Dark desktop theme
captures.description: The same built desktop and live repository using the persisted dark theme.
captures.descriptionYue: 同一個建置桌面同即時倉庫，使用已儲存嘅深色主題。

captures.title: Narrow desktop workspace
captures.description: The real 800 × 700 desktop with compact tab initials and a repository detail view. This is one observed layout, not proof of every screen size.
captures.descriptionYue: 真實 800 × 700 桌面，顯示精簡分頁縮寫同倉庫詳細資料。呢個係其中一個已觀察排版，唔代表所有畫面尺寸都已驗證。

captures.title: Cantonese desktop presentation
captures.description: The same desktop with Cantonese presentation selected. External repository facts remain unchanged; this frame does not establish universal localization.
captures.descriptionYue: 同一個桌面選取廣東話顯示。外部倉庫事實保持不變；呢張畫面唔代表所有介面本機化已完成。

captures.title: Bilingual desktop presentation
captures.description: The same desktop with English and Cantonese presentation selected, preserving provider-authored repository facts.
captures.descriptionYue: 同一個桌面選取英文同廣東話雙語顯示，保留提供者原始倉庫事實。
